digest.component_or_area: Outbound status mapping / inbound label recovery
propositions: Status mapping must become config-driven via per-project overlays on builtin maps, resolved through load_mapping_config and resolve_for_project, enabling remaps and collapses without breaking round-trips
An unmapped local status must drift (omit the status field in Jira mutations, leaving Jira unchanged) with a deduped non-fatal alert, never coercing or failing the mutation

Config-remapped or collapsed statuses must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels, where labels are stamped iff the Jira target differs from the built-in canonical name, and inbound recovery parses labels without needing a reverse map
Outbound seam must resolve the effective map per-project from repo_root (not CWD) and thread it through CREATE/UPDATE mappers and label diff logic via OutboundDiffConfig.repo_root
Fetcher known-set and preflight preflight_status_mapping validation must be widened to tolerate both built-in and config-declared Jira status names, preventing spurious warnings on remapped statuses
A shared helper must replace the duplicated _REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL literal, deriving its recovery vocab from built-in status values and supporting every status the stamp rule emits
